environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 passthrough). The instance runs the Flask app via gunicorn with 4 workers. Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or request inspection. SQLite database on local EBS volume. The Bearer token validation is minimal (length check only) since the architecture assumed an upstream auth proxy that was never deployed.
